title: Breaking AI's 1-GHz Barrier: Sunny Madra (Groq)
talk_summary: A Groq marketing/vision keynote arguing that LLM inference speed improvements will unlock new paradigms (instant responses, always-on background agents, cheap context, multi-agent collaboration).

takeaways.technique: Multi-shot / multi-agent reasoning to punch above model size
takeaways.what_they_do: Cites papers showing that running an existing LLM multi-shot, or having multiple agents work a problem together, raises scores and lets smaller models compete with larger ones.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you just had multiple agents working together on a problem they can far ex of of a less you know less parameter model they can compete with higher parameter models

takeaways.technique: Always-on background agent loop against KPIs
takeaways.what_they_do: Describes 'Pioneer', an automated data-science agent that runs almost endlessly on a problem, watching incoming data against defined KPIs and generating analysis without human prompting.
takeaways.evidence_quote: an agent just constantly you know looking at the new data that's coming in asking additional questions diving into it
